title: BCTalent Stories: Carcyn & Olivia from Clients First

chapters.title: Motivation to join as Business Central consultant
Work environment and talent program benefits

quotes.text: I got firsthand experience as an end user with Erp implementations and really just fell in love with the process
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the motivation for becoming a Business Central consultant - prior hands-on experience with ERP systems.

quotes.text: I appreciate the talent program I'm in I always have individuals as well as content at my fingertips to be able to dive in
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the value of the talent program in providing learning resources and support.

quotes.text: I really have enjoyed being able to go through the the training modules in my own time and not being thrown into projects too
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the self-paced training approach that allows gradual learning before field assignments.

quotes.text: onboarding with clients first was really a Breeze I really got to take everything at my own pace
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the effectiveness of Clients First's onboarding process in accommodating individual learning preferences.

quotes.text: I would strongly suggest taking a look at a career change to a business Central consultant because my work life balance has improved
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides a compelling endorsement of the Business Central consultant career path and its work-life balance benefits.
